digest.component_or_area: test suite maintenance across jira_datacenter and transport modules
propositions: test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport is a tautology because the transport constructor never receives a PAT and the class defines no __repr__, so repr(t) never reveals a credential

test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST predicate inline instead of calling the shared _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default helper, making it unable to detect regressions in the predicate itself

_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default must be parameterized with an optional source argument to allow the teeth test to feed synthetic unpaginated code while the production guard continues calling it with no arguments

test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username only asserts hasattr(cls, validate_assignee_exists), which duplicates the parametrized presence test and never verifies the return value is a username string rather than a bool or accountId
test_every_mutating_transport_member_still_fails_on_the_first_429 uses total <= 1 which is satisfied by zero client calls, preventing detection of members that fail before reaching the client

test_an_unknown_backend_raises_the_registry_error_not_key_error only asserts the class relationship not issubclass(BackendRegistryError, KeyError) without exercising select_backend to verify actual raising behavior
